top_signals.title: Pulte’s Rewewed Attack on Credit Bureaus Sends FICO Plunging
top_signals.summary: Shares of Fair Isaac Corp., Equifax Inc. and TransUnion tumbled on Friday after Federal Housing Finance Agency Director Bill Pulte renewed his long-standing criticism of the costs of consumer credit scores.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: US Open Players Make Fashion Statements, Drive Retail
top_signals.summary:
Dana Telsey, CEO & chief research officer at Telsey Advisory Group, joins Scarlet Fu and Tom Keene on "Bloomberg Money." They discuss the fashion statements being made by players at the US Open and how that translates to consumers.
 (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
